project.description: The project to add cngx to.

preset.description: How much of the onboarding to apply.

x-prompt.message: Which cngx setup do you want?

items.label: recommended - dependencies, theme, a11y providers, lint
full - recommended plus the German language pack, feedback and the floating fallback

libs.description: The @cngx packages to install, comma-separated (--libs core,forms); their @cngx peers follow. Asked when a terminal is attached, otherwise every package.

theme.description: The generated theme file: the cngx default, the Angular Material bridge, or none.

i18n.description: The built-in copy: English only, or the German pack as well.

runtimeSwitch.description: Wire the language pack for switching at runtime instead of a fixed language.

lint.description: Add @cngx/eslint-plugin to the eslint flat config when one exists.

a11yPreferences.description: Provide the accessibility preference axes (density, text scale, motion, contrast) with persistence.

feedback.description: Provide toasts, alerts and banners at the root when @cngx/ui is installed.

floatingFallback.description: Install @floating-ui/dom and provide the popover positioning fallback for browsers without CSS anchor positioning.

aiTools.description: The editors to set up the cngx MCP server for, comma-separated (--ai-tools claude,vscode): the server entry in their project MCP config, a marked cngx block in the agent instructions (AGENTS.md, or CLAUDE.md for Claude Code) and .cngx/README.md. Asked when a terminal is attached, with the detected editors preselected.

yes.description: Apply the plan to an existing app without asking for confirmation first.

prompts.description: Ask the detection-dependent questions when a terminal is attached. Pass false in CI runs under a pseudo-terminal; flags, the recorded answers of a re-run and the preset defaults answer instead.

quiet.description: Print only the summary, not the planned changes.
